header:
Toggles track BC's bit (BitWeight_F4E5FC[BC] = 1 << BC) in the TRACK CLEAR selection mask (0x0DBE) and sets UI_ScreenFlags bit 4 to request a repaint.
TrackClear_OnTrackKey's action on a track key; SongEdit_ResetJobFields zeroes the mask. Basis: caller + caller header + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109788 `calr sub_F4E50B` -- TrackClear_OnTrackKey calls it once the screen latch matches (its header: toggles the track bit in the TRACK CLEAR mask)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109805 `ld xix, BitWeight_F4E5FC` -- bit-weight table, entry k = 1 << k, indexed by HL = BC*2
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109807 `m_xor_mr MW16, 0x0dbe, 3` -- the toggle on the 16-bit mask
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:109808 `m_or_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenFlags, 0x10` -- repaint request
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:144455 `ldw (3518:16), 0` -- SongEdit_ResetJobFields clears the same mask

header:
QUANTIZE's walk, entered by Quantize_Track's jr with the round map in (0x0E12): nothing if STRENGTH (0x0E04) or WINDOW (0x0E05) is 0; seeks measure (0x0C73) of track (0x0C8E) and, for (0x0C77) measures, moves the timing byte (+1) of each 0x9n event toward map[timing] by STRENGTH % (mul / div 100) when it lies inside the window.
Basis: caller + caller header + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135100 `ld (3602:16), xiy` -- Quantize_Track stores the round-map pointer ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135101 `jr sub_F5DBD0` -- ... and jumps here (its header: pulls the timing byte of each 0x9n event toward the map)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135153 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, 0x0e04, 0x00` -- STRENGTH 0 = nothing to do
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135155 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, 0x0e05, 0x00` -- WINDOW 0 = nothing to do
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135161 `call T_BStore_SeekMeasure` -- seek the start measure
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135189 `cp a, 144` -- only 0x9n events
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135201 `mx_ld_rm MXB, ra_HL, ra_IX, 1` -- map lookup of the timing byte
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135265 `mul wa, l` -- distance * STRENGTH ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135267 `div wa, l` -- ... / 100
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135293 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_IX, ra_IY, 7` -- new timing written back in place

header:
Steps the write cursor (block address (0x0CB6), block number (0x0CB4), offset IX) one byte; past 0xFF it follows the +3 NEXT link of (0x0CB6), errors 2 if that block is not allocated, else (0x0CB6) := it and IX = 5; (0x126E) is preserved.
BStore_ReadCursorAdvance's write-side twin: MeasureErase_EraseTrack calls it after each byte it keeps (ld (XHL+IX),A); BStore_RewriteTrackForPart via T_F42710. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136555 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 1` -- MeasureErase_EraseTrack stores a kept byte at the write cursor ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136556 `calr sub_F5EBD4` -- ... and advances it
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136904 `inc 1, ix` -- offset + 1
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136905 `cp ix, 255` -- block boundary at 0xFF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136908 `ld wa, (xhl+3)` -- follow the NEXT link
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136915 `ld (BStore_ErrorCode:16), 2` -- error 2: next block not allocated
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136919 `ldw ix, 5` -- restart at payload offset 5
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136922 `ld (BStore_CursorBlockAddr:16), xwa` -- read cursor block address restored
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:136862 `ld (BStore_ErrorCode:16), 2` -- the twin BStore_ReadCursorAdvance has the same error 2 / offset 5 shape
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:144781 `call T_F42710` -- BStore_RewriteTrackForPart (proposed) advances its write cursor through T_F42710 -> sub_F5EC0E -> here

header:
Rolls MEASURE COPY's destination track (0x0C8F) back to its end on entry (block (0x0D50)[n-1], offset (0x0D70)[n-1], recorded by SongEdit_CopyMeasuresToTrack): if in use, writes 0x82 there, saves that end cursor and truncates the chain after it.
Run when padding the destination (SongEdit_PadDestTrackToMeasure) or the AllocChain that grows it fails. Basis: caller + body (an unlabelled ALL-tracks variant follows at 0xF5FA5C).

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:137838 `mx_st_mr16 MXD, ra_IX, ra_HL, 0` -- ... and its block in (0x0D50)[n-1]

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:137878 `calr sub_F5F9C1` -- padding failed: roll back
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:137944 `m_bit 0, MD16, 0x0d90` -- AllocChain failed after a padding (0x0D90 bit 0) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:137946 `calr sub_F5F9C1` -- ... roll back
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138230 `mx_bit 7, MXD, ra_DE, ra_HL` -- directory entry in use?
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138237 `mx_ld_rm MXW, ra_IX, ra_HL, 3` -- block from (0x0D50)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138244 `mx_ld_rm MXW, ra_IX, ra_HL, 5` -- offset from (0x0D70)

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138271 `call T_BStore_TruncateChainAfterBlock` -- chain cut after that block

header:
Repeats TrackMerge_CopySource1Event until TrackMerge_FetchSource1Event sets (0x0C8B) bit 0, i.e. copies source 1's events into the merged track up to its next 0x81 beat mark or 0x82 end.
TrackMerge_Execute runs it when source 2 already waits at a mark (bit 1) or ended while source 1 still has a beat. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138956 `call sub_F60267` -- both sources at a mark, C (source 1) < B (source 2): source 1 is at a beat, source 2 at its end

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139002 `m_bit 0, MD16, 0x0c8b` -- until source 1 reaches a mark

header:

Twin of TrackMerge_CopySource1ToMark. Basis: caller + body.

header:
Both TRACK MERGE sources stand on the same mark (C == B): for 0x82 writes the end mark, sets (0x0C8B) = 0xFF (done) and saves the destination (0x0C72)'s end cursor at block (0x0D04) / offset IX; for 0x81 writes one beat mark, advances the write cursor and both source read cursors and fetches both next events.
Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138951 `cp c, b` -- TrackMerge_Execute compares the two sources' marks; equal -> here (0xF60222)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139036 `cp c, 130` -- end of both?
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139039 `mx_ld_mi8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 0x82` -- end mark into the merged stream
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139040 `ld (3211:16), 255` -- merge finished
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139046 `call T_BStore_SaveCursor` -- destination end cursor saved
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139050 `mx_ld_mi8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 0x81` -- one shared beat mark

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139066 `call sub_F602F0` -- fetch source 2's next event

header:
Reads source 2's next item from its staging buffer 0x60A100 at (0x0D00): B = status; a 0x81 beat mark or 0x82 end sets (0x0C8B) bit 1 and stays put, otherwise the cursor steps past the status and (0x0D1F) := the event's timing byte.
TrackMerge_Execute primes it after loading source 2's first block; the copy routines call it after each event. Twin of TrackMerge_FetchSource1Event. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138941 `call sub_F602F0` -- TrackMerge_Execute primes source 2
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139087 `ld xix, 6332672` -- source 2's staging buffer
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139088 `mx_ld_rm MXB, ra_IX, ra_IY, 2` -- status byte
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139092 `cp b, 129` -- 0x81 beat mark (0x82 at 0xF60305)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139095 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x0c8b, 0x02` -- source 2 at a mark
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139108 `ld (3359:16), a` -- timing byte kept for the merge comparison (0xF6024A)

header:
Reads source 1's next item from its staging buffer 0x60A000 at (0x0CFA): C = status; a 0x81 beat mark or 0x82 end sets (0x0C8B) bit 0 and stays put, otherwise the cursor steps past the status and (0x0D1E) := the event's timing byte.
Primed by TrackMerge_Execute; TrackMerge_Execute's loop merges by comparing (0x0D1E) with (0x0D1F). Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138940 `call sub_F60338` -- TrackMerge_Execute primes source 1

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138977 `cp a, w` -- TrackMerge_Execute: the earlier timing goes first (ties to source 1)

header:
Copies source 2's current item into the merged stream at the write cursor IX: the status B, then (for an event) its timing (0x0D1F), then its data bytes up to the next status byte, advancing both cursors; then TrackMerge_FetchSource2Event.
TrackMerge_Execute runs it when source 2's event is earlier ((0x0D1E) > (0x0D1F)). Twin of TrackMerge_CopySource1Event. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139169 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 2` -- status written
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139175 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 1` -- timing written
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139188 `mx_bit 7, MXD, ra_IX, ra_IY` -- stop at the next status byte
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139196 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 1` -- data bytes copied
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139200 `call sub_F602F0` -- fetch the next source-2 item

header:
Copies source 1's current item into the merged stream at the write cursor IX: the status C, then (for an event) its timing (0x0D1E), then its data bytes up to the next status byte, advancing both cursors; then TrackMerge_FetchSource1Event.
TrackMerge_Execute runs it when source 1's event is not later than source 2's. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139248 `call sub_F60338` -- fetch the next source-1 item

header:
Copies the 256-byte block at the cursor (0x126E) into the TRACK MERGE staging buffer XIX (0x60A000 for source 1, 0x60A100 for source 2; ldir), returns that block to the free list (T_F42888 -> BStore_FreeChain with IY = (0x345C) block, WA = 1), restores (0x126E) and sets IY = 5.
So the merge frees each source block as it consumes it while it allocates the merged chain. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138902 `calr sub_F60514` -- TrackMerge_Execute loads source 1's head block (XIX = 0x60A000 at 0xF60161)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138913 `call sub_F60514` -- ... and source 2's (XIX = 0x60A100)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139345 `call sub_F60514` -- the source read-advance (sub_F604B7) loads each next block the same way
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139374 `ldw bc, 256` -- 256 bytes
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139375 `ldir85` -- buffer <- block
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139376 `ld iy, (BStore_CursorBlock:16)` -- block number of the consumed block
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139378 `call T_F42888` -- T_F42888 = BStore_FreeChain veneer, WA = 1 block
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:139386 `ldw iy, 5` -- read offset restarts at the payload

header:
For track HL (1-based): clears its directory entry's in-use bit, sets its head to 0xFFFF and resets its saved cursors (0x3460/0x60347E[n-1] := 0xFFFF, 0x3482/0x6034A0[n-1] := 5) without freeing its blocks.
TrackMerge_Execute runs it on both sources after noting their head blocks, before TrackMerge_LoadAndFreeBlock consumes the chains block by block. Basis: callers + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138906 `call sub_F60548` -- source 2 (L = 0x0C71)

header:

Transp0se_Execute calls it for one track or each non-master track of ALL. Basis: caller + caller header + body.

header:
SONG COPY with ALL: for each of the 17 tracks in use in FromSong (live directory if current bank, else bank copy +0x100), starts the ToSong chain (S0ngC0py_AllocDestHeadBlock), duplicates it block by block (251 bytes each) and stores its end cursor (+0x7E/+0xA0); then copies the track-to-part map (+0x22) and the +0x1E long.
Out of blocks: empties ToSong (BStore_EmptyBank) and UI_StatusCode = 15. Basis: caller + caller header + body.

header:
When a block is free: allocates one (BStore_AllocBlock), marks it in use with PREVIOUS 0 and NEXT 0xFFFF, (0x345C) := it, and makes it the head of directory entry (0x0C70) (0-based) in ToSong's bank copy, and in the live directory when ToSong is the current bank.
S0ngC0py_Execute (single track, (0x0C70) = ToTrack-1) and S0ngC0py_CopyAllTracks call it before duplicating a chain. Basis: callers + body.
